physicalNotes: Radius 0.073 Jupiter radii from Marcy et al. 2014 (2014ApJS..210...20M), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2014ApJS..210...20M/abstract): 5,218.9 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. No mass is measured: Marcy et al. 2014 (2014ApJS..210...20M), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2014ApJS..210...20M/abstract) gives only an upper limit of 0.01573168 Jupiter masses, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.
